meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 让它分析你的数据文件(CSV/Parquet/JSON):分组、连接、聚合、时间序列、清洗,并按需画图。它先看文件大小和可用内存,再决定是在内存里算、流式处理还是远程查询。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等数据文件,或做分组聚合、时间序列、画图这类数据任务时触发。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV,按地区分组算平均销售额
say.note: 它先探测文件再选引擎

say.text: 把这份 Parquet 和订单表连接起来看看
say.note: 连接交给 DuckDB 就地完成

say.text: 这份数据太脏,帮我清洗后画出分布图
say.note: 画图按可视化参考执行,含目视检查

howto.what_en: It analyzes your data files (CSV/Parquet/JSON) — grouping, joins, aggregation, time series, cleaning — and charts when asked. It probes file size and free memory first, then places the work in memory, streaming, or remote.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze CSV, Parquet, JSON, or similar files — grouping, aggregation, time series, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV and compute average sales per region
say_en.note: It probes the file before picking an engine

say_en.text: Join this Parquet file with the orders table
say_en.note: DuckDB does the join in place

say_en.text: Clean this messy data and plot its distribution
